summary.text: Baris Duzova is the Liberal candidate for Broadmeadows at the 2026 Victorian election, his second run for the seat after finishing second to Labor's Kathleen Matthews-Ward in 2022. He lives in Glenroy, works in retail while studying law, and is a justice of the peace. His party page highlights living costs and crime.

summary.text: Kathleen Matthews-Ward has held Broadmeadows for Labor since 2022, when she succeeded the retiring Frank McGuire. She was earlier a City of Moreland councillor from 2004 to 2012 and worked as a policy adviser. She is recontesting Broadmeadows in 2026.

legal_and_integrity.text: Suspended from the Labor Party for two years after not voting for the Labor candidate for mayor on her council.

summary.text: Maryam Nasim is standing for the Greens in Broadmeadows at the 2026 Victorian election. She is a university student who grew up in Melbourne's northern suburbs and calls herself a community advocate. Her campaign focuses on the cost of living, climate change and giving young people more of a say in politics.

summary.text: Mohamad Elmustapha is standing as an independent for Broadmeadows at the 2026 Victorian state election, on the VEC's list of nominations. An independent of the same name contested Broadmeadows at the 2022 state election, taking 3.8 per cent of first preferences, and stood for North-West Ward of Moreland (now Merri-bek) City Council in 2020. Neither the ABC nor any other source we found had published a biography of him as at 9 Nov 2026.

summary.text: Mutullah Can Yolbulan, who goes by Mutu, is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Broadmeadows at the 2026 Victorian election. He has lived in Australia since arriving from Türkiye as a student in 2013, and now lives in Jacana and works in IT as an application developer. He stood for the party in Greenvale at the 2022 state election. Locally he has helped organise pro-Palestinian rallies at Hume Council and campaigned for a new park in Broadmeadows.

summary.text: Rachel Unicomb is the Animal Justice Party's candidate for Broadmeadows at the 2026 Victorian election. A Reservoir resident with more than a decade in marketing, she rescues wildlife, fosters cats for animal charities and has written two children's books about conservation. Locally she has supported efforts to protect Edwardes Lake and the Preston Market. The party also ran her in Preston at the 2022 state election.

summary.text: Sue Bolton is standing for the Socialist Alliance in Broadmeadows at the 2026 Victorian election. A long-time socialist campaigner, she has been a councillor in Merri-bek (formerly Moreland) since 2012, when she became the party's first councillor in Victoria, and is in her fourth term. Her past parliamentary campaigns include Pascoe Vale in 2022 and the federal seat of Wills in 2025. The party credits her with campaigns that kept Fawkner's outdoor pool open and led the council to end contracts with firms supplying Israel's military.
